Title: Unauthenticated access
Precondition: Local instance is running; route is confirmed in scope
Input and Steps: Clear test session and request the approved local route
Expected Result: Redirect or deny access without exposing protected data

Title: Role-based authorization
Objective: Verify users cannot exceed assigned permissions
Precondition: Local instance is running; role permissions are documented
Input and Steps: Sign in with a test role and request only approved in-scope resources
Expected Result: Access is limited to the permissions assigned to the role

Title: Session lifecycle
Precondition: A dedicated test account and session are available
Input and Steps: Sign in, sign out, then safely verify whether the old session remains valid
Expected Result: Behavior matches the documented security expectation; revoked sessions cannot access protected content

Title: Input handling
Objective: Verify safe handling of benign test input
Precondition: An approved in-scope form and reset procedure are available
Input and Steps: Submit harmless boundary or marker input defined by the team
Expected Result: Input is handled as data and does not cause unintended execution or exposure

Title: HTTP headers and cookies
Precondition: Local instance is running and response capture is enabled
Input and Steps: Inspect approved responses and cookie attributes
Expected Result: Observed values are recorded and assessed against documented criteria

Title: ZAP scan findings
Objective: Review automated alerts from an approved local scan
Precondition: Local target and ZAP scope are confirmed; data can be reset
Input and Steps: Run passive scan; run active scan only after scope review and approval
Expected Result: Alerts are recorded and individually verified; unverified alerts are not reported as confirmed defects
